_comment: Outside-in evaluator budgets (road-to-credible-install Phase 6). VALUES ARE FROZEN FROM MEASURED ACCEPTANCE NUMBERS of Phases 0-3 (2026-07-27, packed tarball @ 9.8.0 tree, --omit=dev consumer install), never invented. The umbrella harness (src/scripts/evaluator_umbrella.sh) measures the packed artifact and check_evaluator_budgets.ts enforces: absolute budget AND >regression_pct growth vs last_measured fails even under budget. Owner + review date are lint-enforced (lint_budget_ownership). Timing metrics carry a per-entry regression_pct override (200) — wall-clock noise would flap a 10% creep rule; their absolute max is the binding gate. Sizes/counts keep the tight 10% creep.

always_blocking: a metric with no measurement supplied
posture.rationale: road-to-gates-that-can-fail Phase 5. A hard fail on main turns every legitimate command addition into a blocked merge, which is how budgets get quietly raised with a cushion instead of consciously — so budget / regression / drift findings are ADVISORY on main, the nightly and ordinary PRs, and BLOCKING on a release ref. Not a weakening: before the Phase-4 path triggers, this gate ran on release PRs and the nightly only, so the surfaces that now warn never saw it at all. A LOCAL run (no CI env) is strict, because a maintainer running it by hand — including release.ts — wants the strict answer and blocks nobody. A metric with NO measurement is always blocking in either posture: that is a broken harness reporting green on nothing. Implemented in src/scripts/check_evaluator_budgets.ts::detectPosture; override with --posture warn|fail.
posture.delivery: This posture IS the nightly-visibility route (council 2026-08-02, blocker nightly-visibility-owner), not a second mechanism beside it: the nightly publishes measurement_record below, a later run re-measures and compares, and the contradiction warns on main / fails on release. No notification channel, no auto-managed issue — a one-maintainer channel producing routine noise gets muted, and a muted channel reproduces the original failure.

measurement_record.note: Only entries WITHOUT `deterministic: false` participate in the drift comparison. The council's recorded objection was that a non-deterministic comparison produces noise and gets ignored; determinism is therefore a precondition, verified per metric, not an assumption.

verified_against_a_fresh_run.cli_help_command_count: 80 — three consecutive runs of the pinned method on an unchanged tree returned 80/80/80. Matches last_measured; deterministic confirmed.
verified_against_a_fresh_run.mcp_public_tool_count: 19 — two consecutive tools/list runs on a freshly built dist/mcp/server.mjs returned 19/19. Matches last_measured; deterministic confirmed.

remeasurement_2026_08_02.not_re_measured: unpacked_size_mb, node_modules_mb, runtime_dep_count, cli_version_cold_ms, mcp_boot_to_initialize_ms. All five require the packed-tarball harness (npm pack of a fully built tree, then a clean `npm install --omit=dev <tarball>` into a scratch project) that evaluator_umbrella.sh runs in CI. They were NOT re-measured in this pass and their values remain the 2026-07-27 acceptance numbers — stated rather than invented. The next nightly writes the real numbers into measurement_record, and the drift check then reports any contradiction with last_measured on the PR that carries it.

unpacked_size_mb.method: npm pack --json → dist.unpackedSize / 1e6 — includes the Phase-1 precompiled bundles (dist/hooks/dispatch.js + dist/mcp/server.mjs, ~2.1 MB) that bought the 23x hook-latency win and the tsx removal, plus dist/cli-delegate/ (~1.40 MB, ADR-204) which finished that removal for the consumer command surface. This gate is the ONLY size trip-wire on those bundles by design: a dedicated per-bundle budget key would need its own measurement wired into evaluator_umbrella.sh, and an unwired key fails check_evaluator_budgets with 'no measurement supplied' instead of guarding anything. ADR-204 projected 27.45 against max 28 without packing — the next real measurement here is the confirming one, and headroom is thin

node_modules_mb.method: du -sm node_modules after `npm install --omit=dev <tarball>` in a clean project

runtime_dep_count.method: package-lock.json packages count (minus root) of the clean --omit=dev install

cli_version_cold_ms.method: wall-clock of the FIRST `agent-config --version` after install (cold fs cache run counts)

mcp_boot_to_initialize_ms.method: initialize request piped to `node dist/mcp/server.mjs`, wall-clock to response

cli_help_command_count.method: registry enumeration — count of `{ name: '...', disposition` entries in src/cli/registry.ts (NOT --help prose parsing; methods historically disagreed 74 vs 76 vs 79)
cli_help_command_count.baseline_note: 79 → 80 on 2026-07-29 (9.9.0). This RECORDS growth that already shipped through its own reviewed PRs; it does not authorize new surface. Net +6 registry entries since the 9.8.0 tag (7 added — code-graph, knowledge, analytics, memory:get, memory:learn, rtk:detect, dispatch:hook; 1 removed — the old dispatch:hook entry), and the frozen 79 was never re-measured after them. The gate did its job: it made the drift visible at release time rather than letting it accrue silently. Next addition breaches again by design — under the posture above that breach WARNS on main and BLOCKS on release, which is the conscious-decision point rather than a silently raised cap. Re-measured 2026-08-02: still 80, so max and last_measured are both current and headroom is zero.

mcp_public_tool_count.method: tools/list length on the stdio server (post-ADR-132: implemented tools only)
